tagline.en: Keep the agent working when you are not at the desk.
tagline.zh: 人不在电脑旁，也能让 Agent 继续干活。

problem.en: Your agent runs on a workstation, but you are on a train, in a meeting, or on the sofa. Without these tools the session simply stops when you walk away.
problem.zh: Agent 跑在工作站上，而你在地铁上、会议里或沙发上。没有这类工具，你一离开工位，会话就停了。

tagline.en: Never stop because one account hit its limit.
tagline.zh: 不因某个账号额度耗尽而停工。

problem.en: Subscription quotas are finite and reset on their own schedule. These tools pool accounts, watch the remaining quota, and switch automatically so a long task never dies at the limit.
problem.zh: 订阅额度有限，且重置时间不由你控制。这类工具把账号池化、监控剩余额度并自动切换，让长任务不会卡在限额上。

tagline.en: One agent is a worker; several are a team.
tagline.zh: 单个 Agent 是工人，多个 Agent 才是团队。

problem.en: Serial work is slow and a single context window is small. These tools plan, dispatch, isolate and supervise several agents at once — often one git worktree per agent.
problem.zh: 串行干活慢，单个上下文窗口也小。这类工具负责规划、派发、隔离与监管多个 Agent，通常每个 Agent 一个独立工作树。

tagline.en: Run your favourite agent on somebody else's model.
tagline.zh: 让你惯用的 Agent 跑在别家的模型上。

problem.en: The agent loop you like is not tied to the model it ships with. These tools point Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI at DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen or a local model — which is also how you keep working when one vendor's quota is gone.
problem.zh: 你喜欢的 Agent 循环并不必然绑定它默认的模型。这类工具让 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 改跑 DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen 或本地模型——这也是某个供应商额度用尽后的续命方式。

tagline.en: Turn one subscription into a metered, multi-tenant service.
tagline.zh: 把一份订阅变成可计量、可多租户的服务。

problem.en: A single subscription often has more capacity than one person uses. These tools redistribute it safely — with per-user keys, rate limits, quota accounting and billing — instead of sharing a password.
problem.zh: 一份订阅的容量常超过个人所需。这类工具把它安全地再分发出去：独立密钥、限流、额度核算与计费，而不是共享一个密码。

tagline.en: Alternatives to the agent you already pay for.
tagline.zh: 你已在付费的那个 Agent 之外的选择。

problem.en: Sometimes the model access is the point: a flat subscription that unlocks many models, or an open-source agent you can fork. These are the runtimes themselves, not add-ons.
problem.zh: 有时重点在于模型访问权：一份订阅解锁多个模型，或一个可自由 fork 的开源 Agent。这类是运行时本体，而非插件。

tagline.zh: 把你的工作流教给 Agent。

problem.en: A base agent knows nothing about your stack, your review checklist or your deploy process. These packages inject that knowledge as reusable skills, commands, subagents and hooks.
problem.zh: 基础 Agent 不了解你的技术栈、评审清单或发布流程。这类包把这些知识以可复用的技能、命令、子代理和钩子注入进去。

tagline.en: Stop re-explaining your project every session.
tagline.zh: 不必每次开会话都重新解释一遍项目。

problem.en: Context windows end and sessions reset, so the agent forgets decisions you already made. These tools persist project knowledge across sessions and agents.
problem.zh: 上下文会耗尽、会话会重置，Agent 因此忘掉已经定好的决策。这类工具把项目知识跨会话、跨 Agent 持久化下来。

title.zh: 可观测、用量分析与成本

tagline.en: Know where the tokens and the money went.
tagline.zh: 搞清楚 token 和钱都花到哪去了。

problem.en: Agents spend real money in the background. These tools record sessions, chart usage, attribute cost per project, and surface how much quota is left before it runs out.
problem.zh: Agent 在后台花的是真钱。这类工具记录会话、绘制用量曲线、按项目归集成本，并在额度耗尽前提示还剩多少。

tagline.en: Let it run code without letting it run wild.
tagline.zh: 让它执行代码，但别让它失控。

problem.en: Agents execute arbitrary commands with your credentials. These tools contain the blast radius with containers, permission prompts, secret redaction and audit trails.
problem.zh: Agent 用你的凭据执行任意命令。这类工具用容器、权限确认、密钥脱敏和审计日志把影响范围圈住。

tagline.en: Give the agent hands and a common language.
tagline.zh: 给 Agent 一双手，以及一门通用语言。

problem.en: An agent is only as capable as the tools it can call. MCP servers and interop bridges connect it to browsers, databases, issue trackers and other agents.
problem.zh: Agent 的能力上限取决于它能调用什么。MCP 服务与互通桥接让它接入浏览器、数据库、工单系统，以及别的 Agent。

tagline.zh: 每次会话都能省一点力的小改进。

problem.en: Statuslines, notifications, session browsers, prompt managers and review helpers. Individually minor; cumulatively they are the difference between using the agent daily and avoiding it.
problem.zh: 状态栏、通知、会话浏览器、提示词管理与评审助手。单看都不起眼，加起来却决定了你是天天用还是躲着用。
